## Overview

The 2024 EOS Annual Meeting, held in Naples with the Italian Society for Optics
and Photonics (SIOF), ran ten topical meetings and a dedicated session on
**thermal radiation and radiative cooling**: mid-infrared characterisation of
materials, passive daytime radiative cooling, infrared reflectors and thermal
imaging. Its papers form session 13 of the proceedings, EPJ Web of Conferences
volume 309, among them the
[directional spectral emissivity of laser-patterned steel surfaces](/publications/2024/gabirondo-lopez-2/index.html)
from the Thermomat group. The programme archive remains online.
